form_basis: "he shall not deprive her of her necessities" (21:10)

form_basis: court penalty: "he shall surely be avenged by judgment" (21:20)

form_basis: "its flesh shall not be eaten" (21:28)
note: A food prohibition, so Dietary per the brief, but it belongs to the civil penalty on the goring ox; Civil secondary. The stoning clause is a separate provision.

"he shall bring it unblemished before the Lord" (3:1)

form_basis: status rule: "shall be unclean until evening" (11:24)
"he shall confess the sin" (5:5)
note: Confession of sin is a duty toward God (site: Everlasting); in Leviticus 5 it opens the sin-offering procedure, hence Ceremonial secondary.

form_basis: "You shall not wrong your neighbour" (19:13)

form_basis: "shall have his garments loosened" (13:45)

form_basis: "you shall proclaim this day a convocation" (23:21)

form_basis: "to present offerings unto the Lord" (23:37)

form_basis: "He shall take a virgin wife" (21:13)

form_basis: "fields set apart … shall not be sold" (25:34)

penalty: "that soul shall be destroyed from his people" (15:30)

form_basis: status rule: "all her vows shall stand" (30:5)

form_basis: "according to the extent of his vow" (6:21)
